events.title: Performance: The Good Ms. Padgett and Friends!
events.description: Performance: The Good Ms. Padgett and Friends! November 27 @ 11:00 am - 11:30 am Performance: The Good Ms. Padgett and Friends! Inside Art If We Must We Must is an infectious collection of uninhibited songs that effortlessly traverse the diverse terrain of childhood. Lollipops, monsters, singing rabbits, and bedtime are addressed in lovely lullabies and raucous rock jams. The Good Ms Padgett is joined by her daughter Penelope as well as many special guests, both young and older.
